rows.notes: Cayrol, Djian and Pijarowski 1989, Results, Study of the reversibility of the toxic effect, printed page 335/PDF page 5; actual Figure 3 inspected. This recovery result concerns M. arenaria larvae exposed to Brazilian P. lilacinus culture filtrate: 10-day motionless, aerated, illuminated malt culture, 15 g/L, undiluted filtrate, varied exposure, then 24 h in water. Needle probing and water/pH-matched medium controls are described. Summary says less than 48 h, Results through 48 h; no universal threshold is adopted. Typeset all is quoted; PDF text extraction misreads it as dl. Native URL verification is skipped. This is recovery support, not a standalone producer-identity excerpt or proof of a neural mechanism.
